
$playerPrefab = Require-ProjectAsset $projectRoot ([string]$template.player.bodyPrefab) "UNDERDRAIN player prefab"
$arenaPrefab = Require-ProjectAsset $projectRoot ([string]$template.arena.recipe) "UNDERDRAIN arena prefab"
$enemyPrefabs = @($template.enemies | ForEach-Object { Require-ProjectAsset $projectRoot ([string]$_.bodyPrefab) "UNDERDRAIN $($_.kit) prefab" })
$resolvedAssets = @($playerPrefab) + $enemyPrefabs + @($arenaPrefab)
if ($resolvedAssets.Count -lt 7) { throw "UNDERDRAIN production presentation must resolve at least seven core prefabs." }

$jobRoot = Join-Path $projectRoot "local\scene-jobs\$JobId"
$inputRoot = Join-Path $jobRoot "input"
$outputRoot = Join-Path $jobRoot "output"
$trainRoot = Join-Path $outputRoot "player-train"
$logRoot = Join-Path $jobRoot "logs"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $inputRoot, $trainRoot, $logRoot | Out-Null

$sourceArcPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.pilot.arc.json"
$nativeActionSpecPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.action-spec.json"
$canonicalActionSpecPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.canonical.action-spec.json"
$unityProjectionPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.unity-action-spec.json"
$csharpProjectionPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.csharp-projection.json"
$presentationPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "underdrain.effective-presentation.json"
$sceneJobPath = Join-Path $inputRoot "action.scene-job.json"

$generateScript = Join-Path $worldRoot "unity\Conformance\generate-project-authored-action-artifacts.mjs"
$csharpProject = Join-Path $worldRoot "unity\Conformance\Axm.Rodoh.Action.CSharp.csproj"
$runnerV2 = Join-Path $worldRoot "scripts\run-unity-action-local-v2.ps1"
$runnerV3 = Join-Path $worldRoot "scripts\run-unity-action-local-v3.ps1"
$qualifyPlayerProduct = Join-Path $worldRoot "scripts\qualify-unity-action-player-product.ps1"
$buildPlayer = Join-Path $worldRoot "scripts\build-unity-action-player.ps1"
foreach ($path in @($generateScript, $csharpProject, $runnerV2, $runnerV3, $qualifyPlayerProduct, $buildPlayer)) { if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { throw "Required UNDERDRAIN player-train source is absent: $path" } }

$nodeLog = Join-Path $logRoot "underdrain-action-generation.log"
$nodeArgs = @(
    $generateScript,
    "--arc-output", $sourceArcPath,
    "--native-output", $nativeActionSpecPath,
    "--canonical-output", $canonicalActionSpecPath,
    "--unity-output", $unityProjectionPath,
    "--timing-profile", $ExpectedTimingProfile
)
Invoke-Checked "node" $nodeArgs "Generating the exact project-authored UNDERDRAIN Arc and action specs..." $nodeLog

$csharpLog = Join-Path $logRoot "underdrain-action-csharp.log"
$csharpArgs = @("run", "--project", $csharpProject, "--", $nativeActionSpecPath, $csharpProjectionPath)
Invoke-Checked "dotnet" $csharpArgs "Running the independent C# action-contract projection..." $csharpLog

$nodeProjection = Get-Content $unityProjectionPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$csharpProjection = Get-Content $csharpProjectionPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($nodeProjection.actionSpecDigest -ne $csharpProjection.actionSpecDigest) { throw "Node and C# disagree on UNDERDRAIN action-spec identity." }
if ($nodeProjection.arcDigest -ne $csharpProjection.arcDigest) { throw "Node and C# disagree on UNDERDRAIN Arc identity." }
if ($nodeProjection.timingProfileId -ne $ExpectedTimingProfile -or $csharpProjection.timingProfileId -ne $ExpectedTimingProfile) { throw "UNDERDRAIN source generation lost the forgiving timing profile." }
$nodeCues = @($nodeProjection.semanticCues | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.cueId } | Sort-Object -Unique)
$csharpCues = @($csharpProjection.semanticCues | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.cueId } | Sort-Object -Unique)
if (($nodeCues -join "\n") -ne ($csharpCues -join "\n")) { throw "Node and C# disagree on UNDERDRAIN semantic cue coverage." }
if ($nodeCues.Count -lt 17) { throw "UNDERDRAIN production source must expose at least seventeen semantic cues." }

$effectivePresentation = $template | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 | ConvertFrom-Json
$effectivePresentation.sourceActionSpecDigest = $nodeProjection.actionSpecDigest
$effectivePresentationId = "underdrain-bloom-below-$($nodeProjection.actionSpecDigest.Substring(9, 12))"
$effectivePresentation.manifestId = $effectivePresentationId
$effectivePresentation | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $presentationPath
$effectivePresentationSha = (Get-FileHash $presentationPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$sceneJob = [ordered]@{
    format = "rodoh-action-scene-job/1"
    jobId = $JobId
    sessionId = $SessionId
    deviceId = $DeviceId
    unityScenePath = $profile.scenePath
    productId = $profile.productId
    productProfileSha256 = (Get-FileHash $profilePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    arcPath = $sourceArcPath
    arcDigest = $nodeProjection.arcDigest
    actionSpecPath = $nativeActionSpecPath
    actionSpecDigest = $nodeProjection.actionSpecDigest
    timingProfileId = $ExpectedTimingProfile
    expectedResultDigest = $nodeProjection.expectedResultDigest
    authoredPresentation = $presentationPath
    authoredPresentationId = $effectivePresentationId
    authoredPresentationSha256 = $effectivePresentationSha
    presentationAdapterId = $profile.presentationAdapterId
    controlAdapterId = $profile.controlAdapterId
    initialQuality = $InitialQuality
    accessibility = [ordered]@{
        reducedMotion = [bool]$ReducedMotion
        highContrast = [bool]$HighContrast
    }
    expectedCandidate = $nodeProjection.expectedCandidate
    candidateAuthority = "Arc replay required"
    playerProduct = [ordered]@{
        required = $true
